description: PyQt6 desktop application for processing images from SOHO EIT. Input files are FITS files level 0. The application removes impulse noise and periodic noise (square/rectangular grid). This script was created as a part of article "Removal of the Mesh Grid in SOHO EIT Solar Images with a Notch Filter" in the Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series. It explains and derives the mathematical calculations contained therein.
title: Degrid: a desktop application for processing images from SOHO EIT
